name: Chili Piper
description: Chili Piper is a meeting-scheduling and lead-routing platform that automates the path from an inbound web form, chat, or outbound handoff to a booked meeting, qualifying and routing each visitor to the right rep in real time.
best_for: Enterprise B2B teams handling significant inbound traffic (web forms, content, webinars) or outbound-to-AE handoffs who want to remove manual scheduling and lead-routing steps from the path to a booked meeting.
features: Form Concierge, which qualifies and instantly routes inbound leads submitted through web forms
Chat AI, a 24/7 assistant that answers visitor questions, qualifies them, and books meetings directly from the website
Distro, which automatically assigns leads generated from content, webinars, and events to the appropriate rep
Handoff, letting outbound SDRs book a meeting directly onto an account executive's calendar in real time
A centralized routing and scheduling engine handling qualification, routing, and booking logic across all inbound flows
ChiliCal, a standalone calendar-scheduling product sold separately from the core routing suite
Credit-based usage metering (tens of thousands of credits included per year, depending on plan)

tiers.name: Routing & Scheduling
tiers.notes: Totals $15,000/year. Up to 15 seats included, then $45/seat/month. Includes 45,000 credits per year. Its plan family is billed annually only; monthly billing is not available.

tiers.name: Experiences
tiers.notes: Totals $42,000/year. Up to 30 seats included, then $50/seat/month. Includes 150,000 credits per year. Billed annually only; monthly billing is not available.

tiers.name: Chili Data Platform
tiers.notes: Listed as "Coming soon" on the pricing page as of the access date; no price disclosed.

tiers.name: ChiliCal Standalone
tiers.notes: Requires a minimum of 200 seats. The page does not state whether this specific plan is also annual-billing-only.

pros: Publishes real, itemized self-serve pricing (starting price, included seats/credits, and per-seat overage rate) for its two main plans instead of gating everything behind "contact sales"
Certified SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001, and states GDPR and CCPA compliance, per its security page
Combines inbound form qualification, chat-based booking, event/content lead assignment, and SDR-to-AE handoff in one connected routing engine
cons: Its two main plans (Routing & Scheduling, Experiences) require annual billing with no monthly-billing option, and the entry plan totals $15,000/year
No free trial or free plan is offered, per its pricing page
ChiliCal Standalone requires a 200-seat minimum, making it impractical to buy for small teams

faq.question: How much does Chili Piper cost?
faq.answer: Its pricing page lists Routing & Scheduling starting at $1,250/month ($15,000/year, up to 15 seats) and Experiences starting at $3,500/month ($42,000/year, up to 30 seats), both billed annually. ChiliCal Standalone is $12/user/month with a 200-seat minimum.

faq.question: Does Chili Piper offer a free trial?
faq.answer: No. Its pricing page shows no free trial or free plan; the entry point for its main plans is a $15,000/year annual commitment.

faq.question: Is Chili Piper SOC 2 compliant?
faq.answer: Yes. Its security page states it holds a SOC 2 Type 2 report and is ISO 27001 certified, and that it has completed a Salesforce Security Review.

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A widely used scheduling tool that lets people share a booking link so others can pick an open meeting time automatically.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and individuals wanting simple, standalone meeting scheduling without built-in inbound lead qualification or routing.

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open-source scheduling platform offered as both a hosted service and a self-hostable version for booking meetings.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting open-source or self-hosted scheduling with API-level customization.
